title: SDD Assignment 2 system description (system.yaml)
description: Describes every service in the system, how it is configured, what it calls, and where it is deployed on Azure. Must match the code at the graded commit.

student.description: IE username: the part of your IE email before @.

prefix.description: Azure name prefix: the username with dots replaced by hyphens.

public_url.description: The live HTTPS URL of the UI (its storage static website endpoint).

ui.description: The static UI, deployed to an Azure Storage static website.

path.description: Folder of the UI in the repository.

storage_account.description: Name of the storage account serving the UI: the prefix without hyphens, followed by ui (a digit may be added if the name is taken).

calls.description: Services the UI calls from the browser.

azure.description: Shared Azure resources of the system. Every name starts with the prefix.

sql_server.description: Azure SQL logical server hosting every service's database, without .database.windows.net.

registry.description: Image registry and namespace, e.g. ghcr.io/<github-user>.

services.description: The two domain services, keyed by their names in docker-compose.yml.

path.description: Folder of the service in the repository.

openapi.description: Path to the service's OpenAPI document, relative to the repository root.

port_default.description: Port used when PORT is not set.

migrations.description: Folder with the versioned migrations, relative to the repository root.

env.description: Every environment variable the service reads, PORT and DATABASE_URL included.

calls.description: Calls this service makes to other services in the system.

sql_database.description: The service's own serverless Azure SQL database.

default.description: Value used when the variable is not set. Omit only for secrets.

secret.description: True if the value is a secret: it has no default and is set from a GitHub Actions secret.

url_env.description: Environment variable holding the called service's base URL.

endpoints.description: Endpoints called, as 'METHOD /path', matching the called service's OpenAPI document.

on_failure.description: What the user gets when the call fails or times out (§3).
